title: Spring to the button
description: A wood ball rests at (60, 151) on a fixed ramp that slopes down to the right and ends at (137, 113). High on the right, two fixed ledges run level with their tops at y = 122: one from x = 280 to x = 348, one from x = 362 to x = 390. In the 14 cm slot between them a button with 2 cm of travel sits with its cap top at y = 120, 2 cm below the ledges. The build zone covers x from 20 to 380 and y from 2 to 100, below the ledges. The ball has to be thrown up onto a ledge, drop into the slot, and come to rest on the button.
